patch.summary: Set project visibility and published name with an optimistic version
patch.description: Project owners only. Atomically compare the submitted version, set visibility and name, and increment the version, including name-only changes. A stale version returns 409 with error visibility_conflict and changes nothing. Listing exposes name and current owners only to organisation members; it grants no content access. Local-only projects cannot use this endpoint. The published name is explicit metadata and must be refreshed after a project rename.

get.summary: List name-and-owner directory cards for an organisation member
get.description: Requires current membership of the named organisation, including for admins. Returns listed, non-deleted hosted projects only, ordered by project UUID ascending. Cards contain no images, document content, member roster or access grant; non-owners must ask an owner for access outside this API. Private projects remain available through existing owner-only APIs. Membership is checked on every page; never infer it from the client organisation filter.
